description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Model::Ingredients' class, which encapsulates business logic for handling ingredient data structures related to dishes and recipes within the Coocook project. It manages ingredient collections, associated articles and units, and provides methods for data transformation and editing support.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Ingredients
classes.description: A class providing business logic for handling ingredient data structures, including collections of articles, units, and associated project context, with methods for data transformation and editing.

methods.name: build_project
methods.description: Builds and returns the associated project object based on the ingredients.

methods.name: as_arrayref
methods.description: Transforms the ingredients into an array reference of plain data hashes, including associated articles and units, scaled by the factor.

methods.name: for_ingredients_editor
methods.description: Prepares ingredient data for editing, including convertible units for each article, transforming unit objects into plain hashes.
